3-Week Boxing Prep + Mobility Routine
Goal: Improve ankle & hip mobility, build push-up strength, and learn boxing basics
Time/day: ~45 mins | 5 days/week (Mon–Fri)
Equipment: Push-up board, hand gripper, open terrace
Weekly Structure
Day | Focus
Mon (Day 1) | Mobility + Boxing Basics
Tue (Day 2) | Strength + Push-up Progression + Gripper
Wed (Day 3) | Mobility + Shadowboxing
Thu (Day 4) | Strength + Push-up Progression + Gripper
Fri (Day 5) | Mixed Mobility + Shadowboxing + Core
Sat | Recovery / Freestyle (Optional)
Sun | Full Rest / Grip + Light Mobility (Optional)
Day 1 – Mobility + Boxing Basics
**Warm-up (5 mins)**: Jumping jacks – 1 min, Arm swings, hip & ankle rolls – 2 mins, High knees or march – 2 mins
**Mobility (15 mins)**: Follow ankle mobility & hip mobility YouTube routines
**Boxing Basics (15–20 mins)**: Watch jab-cross tutorial + shadowboxing (3 rounds x 2 mins)
Day 2 – Strength + Push-Up Progression + Gripper
**Warm-up (5 mins)**: Shoulder rolls, wrist rolls, squats x 15
**Push-Up Progression (15–20 mins)**: Incline – Knee – Negative Push-Ups (depending on week)
**Hand Gripper (10 mins)**: 3 sets x 15 reps each hand + pulse + hold variations
Day 3 – Mobility + Shadowboxing
**Warm-up**: Same as Day 1
**Mobility Flow (15 mins)**: Repeat ankle + hip drills
**Boxing Shadow Practice (20 mins)**: Mirror stance, jab, cross, 3 rounds x 2 mins
Day 4 – Strength + Push-Up Progression + Gripper
Same as Day 2, increase reps slightly if easier
Day 5 – Combo Day: Mobility + Core + Boxing
**Warm-up**: Dynamic movement
**Mobility (10 mins)**: Quick ankle + hip drills
**Core Routine (15 mins)**: Bicycle crunch, mountain climbers, plank, leg raises
